## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `location` | string |  | Region of the landing zone (Deploy-LiquidwareTier.ps1 passes the spoke VNet location). |
| `namePrefix` | string |  | The landing zone prefix (2-8 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens). |
| `environment` | string |  |  |
| `tierAddressPrefix` | string | `'(address in the source)'` | The tier VNet. /24 or larger; must not overlap the spoke, its peers or the Stratusphere VNet. |
| `spokeVnetId` | string |  | Resource ID of the landing zone spoke VNet (vnet-<base>). |
| `spokeAddressPrefixes` | array |  | The spoke address space. The tier NSGs deny outbound to it. |
| `sessionHostSubnetPrefix` | string |  | Prefix of snet-session-hosts: the only source allowed to reach the console (443, licensing). |
| `spokePrivateEndpointSubnetPrefix` | string |  | Prefix of the spoke private endpoint subnet: the one part of the spoke the tier may reach (the profiles account). |
| `fileDnsZoneId` | string |  | Resource ID of the landing zone privatelink.file zone (Standalone mode). |
| `vaultDnsZoneId` | string |  | Resource ID of the landing zone privatelink.vaultcore zone (Standalone mode). |
| `usersGroupObjectId` | string |  | Object ID of the landing zone users group (the group with SMB Share Contributor on the profiles account). |
| `avdServicePrincipalObjectIds` | array |  | Object IDs of the Azure Virtual Desktop and Azure Virtual Desktop ARM Provider service principals in this tenant. |
| `deployBastion` | bool | `false` | Add AzureBastionSubnet and allow 3389 from it to the console and packaging subnets. |
| `operatorObjectId` | string |  | Object ID of the operator running the deploy: uploads installers to media and may read the console password. |
| `consoleExists` | bool | `false` | True when the console VM already exists: the deploy then leaves the VM and its password alone (lesson 0002). |
| `consolePrincipalId` | string | `''` | The existing console VM identity, when consoleExists. |
| `consoleAdminPassword` | string | `''` | Generated in memory by Deploy-LiquidwareTier.ps1 for a new console only; written to the tier Key Vault, never output. |
| `licenseStored` | bool | `false` | True once Set-LiquidwareSecret.ps1 has stored lw-licstr in the tier Key Vault. |
| `autoShutdownTime` | string | `'1900'` | Daily console shutdown in dev and test, HHmm. |
| `enablePortability` | bool | `false` | Create the portability share on the existing landing zone profiles storage account. |
| `profilesStorageAccountName` | string | `''` | Name of the existing landing zone profiles storage account (when enablePortability is true). |
| `profilesResourceGroupName` | string | `''` | Resource group of the existing landing zone profiles storage account (when enablePortability is true). |
| `enableApplicationRestrictions` | bool | `false` | Create the tier data collection rule for ProfileUnity application restriction events. |
| `logAnalyticsWorkspaceId` | string | `''` | Resource ID of the landing zone Log Analytics workspace (when enableApplicationRestrictions is true). |
| `deployPackagingVm` | bool | `false` | Deploy the on-demand FlexApp packaging VM in snet-lw-packaging. |
| `packagingAdminPassword` | string | `''` | Generated in memory by Deploy-LiquidwareTier.ps1 for the packaging VM only; written to the tier Key Vault. |
| `enableBackup` | bool | `false` | Create the tier Recovery Services vault with an Enhanced backup policy. |
